description: This Scala source file defines utility methods for loading, saving, and processing data in Apache Spark's MLlib, including functions for handling LIBSVM format data, vector and matrix conversions between old and new Spark MLlib types, distance calculations, and fold validation methods.

classes.name: MLUtils
classes.description: Object containing utility methods for data loading, saving, and processing in Spark MLlib.

methods.name: loadLibSVMFile
methods.description: Loads labeled data in LIBSVM format into an RDD[LabeledPoint], with specified features and partitions.

methods.name: saveAsLibSVMFile
methods.description: Saves an RDD[LabeledPoint] in LIBSVM format to a specified directory.

methods.name: loadVectors
methods.description: Loads vectors saved as text files into an RDD[Vector].

methods.name: loadLabeledPoints
methods.description: Loads labeled points saved as text files into an RDD[LabeledPoint].

methods.name: kFold
methods.description: Splits an RDD or DataFrame into k folds for cross-validation, returning training and validation sets.

methods.name: appendBias
methods.description: Returns a new vector with a bias term (1.0) appended.

methods.name: convertVectorColumnsToML
methods.description: Converts old mllib Vector columns in a Dataset to the new ml.linalg Vector type.

methods.name: convertVectorColumnsFromML
methods.description: Converts new ml.linalg Vector columns in a Dataset to the old mllib Vector type.

methods.name: convertMatrixColumnsToML
methods.description: Converts old mllib Matrix columns in a Dataset to the new ml.linalg Matrix type.

methods.name: convertMatrixColumnsFromML
methods.description: Converts new ml.linalg Matrix columns in a Dataset to the old mllib Matrix type.

methods.name: fastSquaredDistance
methods.description: Computes the squared Euclidean distance between two vectors efficiently, with optional norm inputs.

methods.name: log1pExp
methods.description: Computes log(1 + exp(x)) in a numerically stable way.

methods.name: optimizerFailed
methods.description: Logs an error and throws an exception when an optimizer fails.
